findings.title: Independent review gate accepts absent reviewer identity and Root path alias
findings.actual: The exact execute gate accepts actor_id null, empty string, false, empty list, and /root. Exact codex:/root is rejected, but this does not establish an identified independent non-author.
findings.expected: Bind actor_id to the canonical independently designated reviewer codex:/root/attach_fixture_source_review; reject wrong types, blanks, and noncanonical identities before source guard/publication.
findings.impact: A malformed or Root-aliased receipt with all other fields exact can authorize entry into the activation publication path. Controlled execution stopped at the guard read sentinel and performed no Main writes.
